desc: The Frigidaire 30" Electric Range allows you to get meals on the table faster with our 3,000W Quick Boil Element. Enjoy more cooktop flexibility with five cooktop elements designed to handle all of your cooking needs, including the 2-in-1 Dual Expandable Element.
hl: Get meals to the table faster with the powerful 3,000W Quick Boil element.
Experience ultimate cooking flexibility with a cooktop that has five elements designed to handle all of your cooking needs.
Designed to deliver even baking results, every time.
Get two elements in one with the Dual Expandable element - a 6" inner ring for smaller pots and pans and a 9" outer ring for larger cookware.
Large oven capacity allows you to cook more at once.
Redesigned to be even wider - allowing you to store any unused oven racks, baking trays and more!
